background: Helaba is the Landesbank of Hesse and Thuringia, owned by the regional savings banks and the two states, a wholesale and real-estate lender that also acts as the central bank for its savings banks and owns the Frankfurter Sparkasse.
synthesis: Two of the three main agencies rate the bank, AA- on average and both on a stable outlook, after a one-notch upgrade by one of the three on 12 May 2026. Its ratios sit around the middle of EU and Nordic banks: CET1 of 15.8% at the median, leverage of 5.4% just below it, LCR of 168% above it and NSFR of 120% below it. Since 30 Jun 2025 CET1 has fallen 0.5 points while the other ratios have held (figures to 30 Jun 2026); the high rating reflects the savings-bank network behind it more than its own figures.
